verdict.description: APPROVED = buildable as written, no P0/P1 left · REVISE = fixable problems · BLOCKED = needs a human decision or missing information

severity.description: P0 builds the wrong thing or loses data/security · P1 a real user gets a wrong result · P2 edge case · P3 minor

section.description: Plan heading or step the finding is about

evidence.description: File, line, doc or concrete input that shows the problem

fix.description: The change to make to the plan
